caseNameFull: Hijar, Superintendent, Federal Prison Camp at Boron, California v. Burrus

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, ante, p. 816.] Judgment vacated and case remanded to the United States District Court for the Northern District of California with instructions to vacate the injunction and to dismiss the cause as moot.
